name: Scroll Overview (hlsovpp)
author: jgarza (fork of yayuuu/hyprland-scroll-overview)
description: A fork of yayuuu's ScrollOverview: a niri-style zoomed-out overview of every workspace, drawn by Hyprland itself. This fork adds per-window motion, so windows ripple, sweep, scatter or spring into place instead of moving in lockstep. After adding, run ./install in the plugin folder to build the native plugin. Settings: Omarchy menu > Style > Scroll Overview.
